inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. That staff have had to threaten disruption just to get long-delayed talks treated as urgent shows how universities and government can rely on workers’ labor while sidelining their demands. The answer is not to blame workers for defending their rights, but for the government to negotiate seriously and reach a fair agreement before the dispute escalates further.
